# Fix handling of IS_RELEASE='' in lib build script

## Pull Request by @mateuszsikora

in build script we had: `process.env.IS_RELEASE !== undefined;` so in case of `IS_RELEASE=''` it was true

## Summary by CodeRabbit

* **Refactor**
  * Improved build system version detection logic for more consistent release mode identification.

<!-- end of auto-generated comment: release notes by coderabbit.ai -->
## Walkthrough

The `getVersion` function in `bin/lib/scripts/build-lib.ts` has been modified to determine release mode by evaluating `process.env.IS_RELEASE` as a truthy value using `Boolean()` instead of checking whether the variable is defined. This changes the logic so that empty strings and other falsy values now result in non-release behavior, while any truthy value triggers release behavior.

## Estimated code review effort

🎯 2 (Simple) | ⏱️ ~8 minutes
